1. Qualified steam: steamTemp in [447.0, 453.0] AND steamPressure in [3750.0, 3850.0] (closed interval)
2. qualifiedTon += steamFlow * scanSeconds / 1000.0 when qualified AND enable=TRUE AND no dataFault
3. fuelTon += fuelFlow * scanSeconds / 1000.0 whenever enable AND no dataFault (regardless of qualified)
4. Data fault: scanSeconds <= 0.0 OR scanSeconds > 10.0 OR steamFlow outside [0,90] OR fuelFlow outside [0,6]
5. resetBtn rising edge: clears both accumulators, takes priority over fault freeze
6. revenue = qualifiedTon * 280.0, cost = fuelTon * 1500.0, netProfit = revenue - cost
7. qualifiedTon, fuelTon, revenue, cost must be non-negative

```st
FUNCTION_BLOCK FB
VAR_INPUT
    enable : BOOL;
    resetBtn : BOOL;
    scanSeconds : LREAL;
    steamFlow : LREAL;
    fuelFlow : LREAL;
    steamTemp : LREAL;
    steamPressure : LREAL;

    qualified : BOOL;
    dataFault : BOOL;
    qualifiedTon : LREAL;
    fuelTon : LREAL;
    revenue : LREAL;
    cost : LREAL;
    netProfit : LREAL;
END_VAR

VAR
    prevResetBtn : BOOL := FALSE;
    prevFuelTon : LREAL := 0.0;
    prevQualifiedTon : LREAL := 0.0;
END_VAR

// Determine qualified status

             (steamPressure >= 3750.0) AND (steamPressure <= 3850.0);

// Check for data faults
dataFault := (scanSeconds <= 0.0) OR (scanSeconds > 10.0) OR 
             (steamFlow < 0.0) OR (steamFlow > 90.0) OR 
             (fuelFlow < 0.0) OR (fuelFlow > 6.0);
```

After updating the accumulators, I calculate revenue based on qualified tons, derive costs from fuel consumption, and compute net profit as the difference. Finally, I store the current reset button state to detect rising edges on the next cycle.
